name: Jelly Radio
description: A row of chips for picking an option; the chip you click swells and the others give way with a springy shove.
interactionNotes: Click any chip and it grows while the others shrink slightly and move aside; the farther away they are, the later they go. You can also move between options with the arrow keys, and Home/End jump to either end. Selection is the same with click and keyboard, so both feel identical.

props.name: items
props.description: The options; you can pass strings, or objects with value, label, icon and disabled.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. If you want uncontrolled, do not pass this and pass defaultValue instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The selected option in uncontrolled mode; defaults to the first option.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Returns the new option's value and index on every selection.

props.name: size
props.description: Chip size: sm 28, md 36 and lg 44 pixels.

props.name: chipColor
props.description: Background color of the inactive chips.

props.name: activeColor
props.description: Background color of the selected chip.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color of the inactive chips; the same color is used when the pointer moves over them.

props.name: activeTextColor
props.description: Text color of the selected chip.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between chips, in pixels.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the chips; for a fully pill-shaped chip, pass half the height.

props.name: swell
props.description: How much larger the active chip grows, relative to its own size.

props.name: barge
props.description: How many extra pixels the neighbours are pushed aside.

props.name: shrink
props.description: How much the neighbours shrink.

props.name: jelly
props.description: Intensity of the jelly feel. At 0 the motion becomes a simple zoom; above 1 the stretch gets exaggerated.

props.name: bounce
props.description: Spring bounciness. Above 0.4 it looks too resonant.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Time offset at which each neighbour starts moving, in milliseconds.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring stiffness; lower means softer and slower.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables and dims the whole group.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Group label for screen readers; keep it close to the question's topic.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class on the group root; for custom spacing or width.

tips: For choices picked over and over, set `bounce` around 0.15; less bounce, calmer.
If the chip labels are long, increase `size` rather than `gap`; a large gap scatters the group.
You can also pass colors with a CSS variable, like `var(--color-brand)`.
